items.title: MECH-490 sleep commit-gate persistence: spawn-matched + commit-variance instrumented sleep-vs-no-sleep ablation (V3-EXQ-913 successor, 6 seeds)
items.note: MECH-490 (registered 2026-08-11, sleep_transition_investigation_906_lineage_2026-08-10.md Section 13) V3-EXQ-913 successor implementing its own non-degeneracy precondition (what_would_answer). V3-EXQ-913's sleep_ablation_comparison block (claim_ids=[] at run time, non_contributory, never scored against a claim) was reanalyzed and found weakly suggestive but underpowered (n=4 usable matched windows, 2 seeds, best sign-test p=0.25) AND carrying a genuine unflagged confound: agent spawn position differed between WITH_SLEEP/NO_SLEEP arms at every one of its 5 matched segment-index comparisons (5-11 cell Manhattan distance), because env.reset_to() only guarantees hazard/resource layout continuity, not spawn point, and 913's own _continuity_reset() drew spawn from each arm's own env._rng, whose state diverges between arms from segment 1 onward. This script fixes that: _spawn_order_for_segment(seed, segment_index, board_size) draws a shared, arm-independent candidate order keyed only on (seed, segment_index), so both arms are offered the identical order (each still safety-filters against its own live hazard-drift state, so not forcibly identical -- every comparison logs spawn_position_matched + spawn_manhattan_distance). Second fix: agent.e3.get_commitment_state() (existing public API, e3_selector.py:3990) read once per env step, aggregated per matched window into commit_gate_engagement_rate / mean_running_variance -- the direct mechanistic instrumentation MECH-490 names. Third: seeds 2 -> 6 (SEEDS_DEFAULT=[0..5]), addressing 913's own sample-size ceiling. Pre-registered thresholds: SPAWN_MATCH_RATE_FLOOR=0.8, SIGN_TEST_ALPHA=0.05, MIN_SEEDS_FOR_CONFIRM=5, COVARY_R_FLOOR=0.3 (all in-script, not inferred post-hoc). evidence_direction computed per MECH-490's own confirming/falsifying signature: non_contributory if the non-degeneracy precondition (spawn_match_rate>=0.8 AND commit-gate instrumented) is unmet or the coherence lift (mean_run_length sign-test) is not significant across >=5 seeds; supports if significant AND covaries with commit-gate-engagement-rate delta (Pearson r>=+0.3); weakens if significant but does NOT covary (mechanism-wrong-even-if-behaviour-real, MECH-490's falsifying signature part 1). The "matched no-sleep control" falsifying alternative is already inherent in this two-arm design's NO_SLEEP arm (same elapsed time/segment index, never fires sleep) -- no separate arm needed. OUT OF SCOPE (Section 13d items 4-5, deferred to a later successor gated on this run's result): transfer test to a different ecology, blinded-umpire classifier. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (spawn-matched + commit-instrumented WITH_SLEEP-vs-NO_SLEEP delta covarying with commit-gate engagement) recorded in no existing manifest -- 913 carries neither fix; not recoverable, run required. Re-derive brake (2.5b): MECH-490 registered today, zero prior /failure-autopsy targets -- does not fire. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): checked substrate_queue.json for open corrupting/degrading entries touching e3_selector.py/causal_grid_world.py/the 906b-664-665-913-scaffolded_sd054 driver family -- none found. Smoke PASS (--dry-run --seeds 0 1, all 4 cells verdict PASS; seed 1's with_sleep/no_sleep spawn positions matched exactly at all 3 compared segments, confirming the fix engages; z_goal_stream active_frac=0.998, no writer defect; dry-run manifest + episode-log companion correctly relocated by emit_outcome's dry_run handling). validate_experiments.py --strict clean, 0 warnings across all lint categories including stale-e3-diagnostics (the per-env-step get_commitment_state() read is a STATE read, not a select()-latch re-read -- see module docstring). Does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-913's other findings (layout continuity, microhabitat probabilistic-habitat-cue) -- those are inherited unchanged, not this run's test target.

items.title: SD-016 production-combination validation (gumbel selection + ctxdiv-loss + differentiable-CEM): MECH-150/151/152/ARC-041, first combined run
items.note: SD-016 selection-mechanism gap resolved 2026-08-09/10 by the GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio (V3-EXQ-907 H1 ctxdiv-loss CONFIRMED, V3-EXQ-908 H3 gumbel-selection CONFIRMED/topk ELIMINATED), promoted into substrate ree-v3 110a2785b6 (chip-20260810-sd016-h1-h3-combine; 8 new contracts, full suite green 3565 passed). Recommended PRODUCTION COMBINATION (config.py E1Config docstring ~line 494): sd016_cue_slot_tagger=True, sd016_cue_slot_tagger_selection='gumbel' (NOT 'topk' -- eliminated), sd016_context_divergence_weight=0.5. This exact three-knob combination has NEVER been run together -- 907/908 each tested one axis in isolation. substrate_queue.json SD-016 unblocks_claims: MECH-150, MECH-151, MECH-152, ARC-041, INV-040, SD-017. This entry runs the combination for the first time: 2 arms (A0_OFF control, A1_PRODUCTION = the combo) x 3 seeds [42,43,44], V3-EXQ-907/908 harness pattern (SD-070 P0a=60 warmup, readiness preconditions, phased P1=40 E1-only training), PLUS a COLLECTION_EPISODES=20 continuous-rollout phase (V3-EXQ-194a methodology) for MECH-152's Pearson correlations. MECH-150 (confirmatory, ALSO the readiness gate for 151/152/ARC-041): sel_entropy_mean<2.5 AND sel_context_divergence>0.1 on A1_PRODUCTION majority-ready-seeds, A0_OFF stays on the ln(16) saddle (entropy>2.65) as C2 control; unmet -> whole run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (an untrained/degenerate retrieval would otherwise masquerade as a MECH-151/152 falsification). MECH-151 (E2 leg): action_bias_div paired-per-seed > A0_OFF control on majority ready seeds (no absolute floor is grounded -- every prior 907/908/898/418m report marks this quantity non-gating since retrieval was never genuinely selective before now). Runs with use_differentiable_cem=True (SD-055) armed throughout per spec, WITH AN HONEST CAVEAT recorded in the script docstring: P1 trains cue_action_proj via the same direct-supervision recipe 907/908 validated (MSE against E2.action_object().detach()), which never calls HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories() and so never routes gradient through the CEM elite-refit SD-055's dead-gradient fix targets -- this driver tests MECH-151's mechanism claim (does action_bias become context-conditioned once fed genuinely selective retrieval), NOT SD-055's gradient-restoration mechanism specifically; a genuine SD-055 test would need a materially different, higher-risk driver routing a live (non-detached) action_bias through propose_trajectories with no existing validated recipe (V3-EXQ-568 was a diagnostic grad_max smoke test only) -- flagged as a follow-on, not built here. MECH-152 (E3 leg): terrain_weight from the REAL end-to-end retrieval path (z_world -> ContextMemory -> cue_context -> cue_terrain_proj), not V3-EXQ-194a's standalone TerrainHead bypass; r_w_harm/r_w_goal Pearson correlation vs hazard_max, thresholds inherited from 194a (r_w_harm>0.5, r_w_goal<-0.3). DEVIATION FLAGGED: uses 194a's CORRECTED w_goal_target threshold (<0.33), NOT 907/908's compute_terrain_loss formula (<0.1) which unnoticed-ly inherited EXQ-194's ORIGINAL broken threshold (hazard field floor ~0.22 under num_hazards=1/use_proxy_fields=True means <0.1 nearly never fires -- the documented cause of EXQ-194's own r_w_goal=-0.007 FAIL); 907/908 never noticed since they only gated on selection entropy/divergence, not on terrain_weight regression quality, so the stale threshold was inert for their purposes but would NOT be inert here where r_w_goal is a load-bearing criterion. ARC-041 (dual-pathway dissociation, gated on mech150_confirmed): per claims.yaml's own what_would_answer, BOTH MECH-151 and MECH-152 passing = confirmed_dual_pathway; exactly ONE passing = falsified_dissociation (names which pathway survives, per claims.yaml this falsifies ARC-041 specifically even though the surviving pathway's own claim stands); NEITHER passing = neither_pathway_confirmed (a genuine null on both, NOT excused by claims.yaml's non-degeneracy caveat since retrieval is confirmed selective in this branch). INV-040 (temporal precedence) EXPLICITLY DEFERRED -- checked before deciding: env DOES support an early-visible hazard gradient without SD-023 landmarks (CausalGridWorldV2's hazard_field_view is documented 'continuous, smooth, autocorrelated, agent-independent', already present under use_proxy_fields=True which this driver already uses) and latent.z_harm_a is already returned every step, so the 'env does not support it' escape does not apply; deferred anyway because INV-040's precedence-timing statistic (first-crossing thresholds for w_harm vs z_harm_a, averaged over episodes classified as 'hazard visible early') is a materially different measurement design from anything MECH-150/151/152/ ARC-041 need, with no Step-2.5a probe of its own -- grafting an under-designed new measurement onto an already-substantial 4-claim combined driver risks compromising the core design; a dedicated follow-on (own driver, own Step-2.5a probe) is recommended but not queued or chipped by this session. SD-017 explicitly OUT OF SCOPE (separate, unrelated slot_cosine_sim occupancy-mask DV defect per the orchestrating session's own investigation; its own follow-on gap -- V3-EXQ-436e re-run referenced-but-never-actually-chipped -- is being reported/chipped separately by the orchestrating session, not this entry). SD-055 status_note: claims.yaml SD-055 is status=candidate/v3_pending, exp_conf=0 -- its own behavioural validation was never run before now; this entry is also the first behavioural exercise of use_differentiable_cem=True end-to-end in a real training driver (subject to the MECH-151 caveat above that it does not specifically probe the CEM-gradient route). GATES (per orchestrating session, already cleared, not re-run here): Steps 2.4/2.5/2.5a/2.5b/2.5c. Step 2.5a empirical probe re-verified this session directly against current source (config.py wiring lines for sd016_* and use_differentiable_cem/differentiable_cem_temperature at both dataclass and from_dims sites; e1_deep.py extract_cue_context/compute_context_divergence_loss; agent.py _integrate_e1 consumer wiring; e3_selector.py terrain_weight w_harm/w_goal consumption; hippocampal/module.py differentiable-CEM softmax-weighted refit) -- all confirmed present and matching the brief, no wiring gap found. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readouts (sel_entropy/sel_context_divergence under the COMBINED three-knob config; action_bias_div under use_differentiable_cem=True; r_w_harm/r_w_goal via the real retrieval path) exist in NO recorded manifest -- genuine new run. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, seed 43 A1_PRODUCTION cell cleared even p0a=2's readiness and produced non-trivial decisive readouts: sel_entropy=0.0000 sel_ctx_div=1.0000 action_bias_div=0.0146 r_w_harm=0.0366 r_w_goal=-0.1513, no crash, no WRITER DEFECT signature). validate_experiments.py --strict clean, 0 warnings across all lint categories.
